goal: Prevent Tor control command injection and malformed address handling when connecting to Tor hidden services
Validate onion service IDs and private keys returned by the Tor control port and cached on disk
reviewability: All review comments have been addressed and accepted
agreement: Strong substantive support with all feedback addressed and no open objections
Supported after strict key validation and per-reply state isolation were added (vasild)
Confirmed CRLF handling and prompted fixes for space-based argument injection (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents control command injection from a compromised or rogue Tor control port
Stops injected commands like shutdown signals from causing denial of service on reconnect
